notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup. Primary contact: Maya Rios (Sr. Eng, Platform). Use-case: inline chat on product pages + personalization queries. They run a mix of short chat prompts (10-80 tokens) and weekly reindex embeddings. Main complaint: perceived latency variance across regions and occasional connection timeouts in EU customers. Maya: "we see spikes at 09:00 and 17:00 PST, page conversion drops when bot is slow". Tech constraints: fully on public cloud, cannot use private connectivity yet. Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for reliable p95 but want guidance to avoid runaway token usage.

SE notes / recommendations made in call:
- Region guidance: route CA/US west traffic to us-west-2, EU traffic to eu-west-1 (avoid eu-central for their infra due to increased RTT observed in traces).
- Client/timeouts: set API client socket timeout to 30s, request timeout to 15s for interactive flows, enable exponential backoff with jitter for retries.
- Prompt guidance: trim system messages, truncate user history beyond 1.5k tokens for product-page chat, set max_tokens to 64 for quick answers; use embeddings + similarity rerank for product search to reduce generation tokens.
- Perf knobs: enable prefix/KV caching for frequent product Qs, start with model family small-medium (quantized) for low-latency endpoints; evaluate larger model for occasional heavy ops via routed fallback.
- Observability: add token/latency tags per route; ship traces to Redwood Console for first 2 weeks to calibrate batching and autoscaling.

Open items:
- They want a short, copyable playbook for engineers (1-pager) and an annotated config example for node/python SDKs.
- Need price estimate for steady 50 rps sustained on hosted API vs Dedicated baseline.
- Security: they asked about SAML SSO + SOC2 timeline; RD team to share security FAQ link.
